item.title: TIB urges govt to cancel BB governor appointment

item.title: 7-day holiday for Eid-ul-Fitr
item.description: To facilitate smooth travel for people heading home during Eid, the government has declared an additional holiday on March 18. As a result, government employees will enjoy a continuous seven-day holiday from March 17 to March 23 for Eid-ul-Fitr.The decision was taken at a Cabinet meeting held at the Secretariat on Thursday with PrimeMinister Tarique Rahman in the chair.While talking after the meeting, State Minister for Primary and Mass Education Bobby Hajjaj confirmed the matter to journalists.

item.title: Jamaat demands trial of Rizwana, Khalil over 'election engineering'
item.description: Bangladesh Jamaat-e-Islami on Thursday demanded that former advisers Syeda Rizwana Hasan and Khalilur Rahman be brought under legal scrutiny, interrogated and tried over their alleged role in what the party described as "election engineering."The demand was made at a press conference held at the party's central office in Moghbazar in the capital to discuss the prevailing political situation. item.title: Man dies after assault while mediating dispute in Munshiganj
item.description: An elderly man died after allegedly being assaulted while attempting to mediate a domestic dispute in Banglabazar area of Munshiganj district.The deceased was identified as Monir Mollah, 70. He died around 8:30 AM on Thursday while undergoing treatment, a day after the incident occurred.According to locals, the incident took place around 9:30 AM on Wednesday at Charbanial (Uttar Bhukailash) village under Banglabazar union. item.title: Middle East conflict escalates as Israel bombs Beirut
